description: Sponsor-authored control record for a single Bluebird explorer device. One record per explorer, at a RANDOM record key (never the explorer's name). Lives in the sponsor's own ATProto repo and is read publicly (unauthenticated com.atproto.repo.getRecord) by the explorer's device. Carries the two switches (localOnly, skin), the pause switch, the curated inclusion list grouped into toggleable channels, curated friends, approved discovery feeds, and per-explorer switches. Contains NO age, birthday, school, or location and nothing private. Follows are NOT in this record; they belong to the explorer.

version.description: Config schema version. 2 for the two-switch model.

tier.description: Trust distance from the tended garden: green = inside the garden, blue = one hop beyond it, black = the open network. This is a trust rating, not a content-maturity rating.

displayName.description: The explorer's nickname — never a real or legal name. Guidance is enforced in the sponsor UI; this field is public like the whole record.

localOnly.description: Switch 1. Default true: no account, the device makes only anonymous public GETs. False: the explorer has an account and likes/follows exist.

skin.description: Switch 2. Purely cosmetic. No capability ever keys on skin.

paused.description: The pause switch / kill switch. When true the explorer's device locks the garden on its next successful poll.

updatedAt.description: When the sponsor last changed this config.

channels.description: Named, individually toggleable groupings of accounts. The explorer's effective inclusion list is the union of accounts across enabled channels.

friends.description: Reciprocal, sponsor-curated friends (by DID) whose hearts may be shown among friends.

showFriendsHearts.description: Let a localOnly explorer see friends' hearts via anonymous reads (see-but-not-be-seen). Default false.

search.description: Open search (Telescope rung 2) — a sponsor-set trust gradient. Legacy boolean `telescope` migrates to search.tier (true→open, false→off).

showReposts.description: Whether reposts (whole outside posts) are injected into the garden. Default true.

staleHours.description: Hours the config may be unreachable before the garden locks. Default 72.

help.description: Optional trusted-adult contact for the out-of-band 'something's wrong' handoff.

enabled.description: Whether this channel is currently shown to the explorer.

actor.description: A handle or DID of an included account (getAuthorFeed accepts either).

name.description: Sponsor-cached display name at approval time.

tier.description: Reach: off (approved feeds only) / discovery (approved-feed authors) / open (whole network).

useAllowlist.description: Positive gate: only queries matching an allowed topic run. Default false.

allowlistExtra.description: Sponsor additions to the seeded topic allowlist.

useBlocklist.description: Negative gate: queries with a blocked term are refused. Default true.

blocklistExtra.description: Sponsor additions to the seeded blocklist.

logHistory.description: Search history visible to the sponsor (accountability). Default true.

auditPubKeyJwk.description: When set, the sponsor's audit PUBLIC key (EC P-256 JWK) for the encrypted search-history archive. Present ⇒ the explorer device seals each search to it (ing.croft.bluebird.search); absent ⇒ history stays on-device. Never a private key.
